statement: A mandatory registry of large training clusters (or chip-location tracking) operates in >= 2 of the top-3 jurisdictions (official gazettes; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2023. Bloc A ordered (but had not yet operationalised) mandatory reporting of large computing clusters' existence and location; no verified equivalent cluster registry existed in Bloc B or the third jurisdiction. Bloc A's export-control updates tightened chip controls but did not create location tracking.

items.summary: Bloc A executive order directs that entities acquiring, developing or possessing a potential large-scale computing cluster report its existence, location and total computing power; interim threshold: co-located clusters linked at >100 Gbit/s with a theoretical maximum of 1e20 operations per second for AI training. First jurisdiction with a cluster-reporting mandate (implementation pending in-phase).
items.detail: Bloc A EO 14110, sec. 4.2(a)(ii) and 4.2(b)(ii), 88 FR 75191, published 2023-11-01 (signed 2023-10-30). Commerce to implement via Defense Production Act authority.

items.summary: Bloc A updated its advanced-computing chip and chip-tool export controls toward Bloc B and arms-embargoed destinations and added entities to its restricted list; controls on exports, not a cluster registry or chip-location tracking.
items.detail: Bloc A Commerce BIS press release, 'Commerce Strengthens Restrictions on Advanced Computing Semiconductors, Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, and Supercomputing Items to Countries of Concern', 2023-10-17 (updating the 2022-10-07 rules).

items.summary: No verified source found of a mandatory training-cluster registry or chip-location tracking in force in Bloc B or the third major jurisdiction during 2023; Bloc B's generative-AI measures regulate public services, not compute infrastructure.
items.detail: Checked: Bloc B CAC 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》 (2023-07-13) - service-level rules, no cluster registration provision found in extracted text. Bloc C AI Act only at provisional-deal stage (Dec 2023). Absence-of-evidence item; reviewer may wish to check Bloc B's computing-power infrastructure plans (e.g. Oct 2023 MIIT action plan) in a later pass.
